trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so it arrives last and only after the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy in the set, which means a single playthrough plus cleanup is enough. The longest road here is the 100% completion checklist, so treat every other trophy as a checkpoint on the way to it. Nothing in the list is reported as glitched, so the platinum is fully earnable with patience.

steps.text: The platinum pops only after all 54 other trophies are earned.

The 12 story trophies come automatically from finishing chapters and named missions.
The two gold trophies are A Long Road and the final-mission trophy.

It is hidden, so its name and description stay masked until you earn it if the spoiler shield is on. Expect it within the first hours of the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This is the second gold trophy and the hardest one in the set: it needs the full 100% completion checklist, which only opens after you finish the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The checklist is softer than it sounds — the real completion behind the 100% label is roughly 60% — but it still spans story tasks, exploration, and discovery across all of Leonida. Progress you make during the story counts toward it, so you are never starting from zero. Treat it as the final cleanup stage, not a trophy to chase early.

Discovery carries the remaining 10% of the checklist weight.

The checklist needs 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, and 15 of 18 card sets.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be done in free-roam.
The trophy pops when the checklist reaches 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: This silver asks for 250 stunts out of the 397 scattered across Leonida, and you may mix the four kinds however you like. Under-the-bridge runs are the fastest to rack up, while stunt jumps, knife flights, and base jumps fill in the rest. Track your count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or check the map's stunt spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so this trophy pops on the way there without any extra grind.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to sample nine different activity types once each, and most of them happen naturally while you chase other trophies. Fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt are the nine. Check your progress under the touchpad menu, then Progress, then Activities. If one type is missing late in the game, it is usually the video game or the pool match, both of which take only a few minutes.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: This silver is often called the second-hardest trophy after A Long Road: gold medals in all 42 shooting-range challenges across 12 locations. Raise your Focus level first, because a higher Focus makes the timed challenges far easier — short shooting-range loops themselves build Focus quickly. Eighteen of the challenges sit at Griffin, with the other 24 spread across the remaining locations. The 100% checklist needs the same 42 golds, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: This silver asks you to scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on your phone — hold D-pad Up and press R1 while pointing at a spot. There are more than 100 scannable locations, split across landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, and No Flusher tags, so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel instead of saving it all for the end, and the trophy will pop during normal exploration. The 100% checklist needs the same 100 scans, so the two finish together.

Any 100 locations count; you do not need a specific set.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: This bronze asks for 50 of the 80 challenges listed under Progress, then Challenges. Most challenges complete themselves while you play — driving, shooting, exploring, and robbing all feed into them — so check the list near the end and mop up the easiest ones left. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so this trophy pops well before the checklist is done. It is pure cleanup, with no special setup required.

It is listed as a bronze activities trophy.

Its unlock is confirmed by the official trophy list and the PowerPyx guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to hit a four-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone entirely. It opens after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission, once you can call your partner with a hold of D-pad Right plus Triangle. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle to follow on the rails and helicopters cannot see you. It also pops on its own during the big bank-vault robberies, which always trigger four stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time — keep the wanted level flashing red and blue, and never let it drop into the red heat zone. Bring body armor, sticky bombs, and Zombix or Adrenaline for the run. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, and if it does not, rob a fourth. Three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, once the Chapter 3 jewelry jobs have opened them up.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to discover 100 unique vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — hold D-pad Up, point at a vehicle, and hold R1. You do not need to drive them; scanning alone counts. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes, and the count climbs fast. There are 557 vehicles in total across 277 base models, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of those base models scanned, so this trophy pops early on the way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus, which you trigger with L3 plus R3 while aiming. Time slows for only a few seconds, so set it up well: raise your Focus level first, eat and drink to buff it, and take Adrenaline by holding L1 and pressing Triangle to stretch the duration. Use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, wear body armor, and pick a spot with five enemies close together, such as a gang operation. Note that it does not work on soldiers, police, or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to steal a large passenger plane that is connected to a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport — not one of the small planes sitting on the field. Terminals E3 and E4 hold the easiest targets. Get in through the airfield fence, climb the stairs beside a boarding bridge, and walk straight into the plane. Once inside, head up to the cockpit, reverse onto the runway, take off, and fly at least a kilometre from the airport until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to steal a military Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, an island in the southwest of the map in Mariana County. The tanks sit in the south of the base, and you can get in through the gate or over a stunt jump in the southeast. Climb into the tank and start shooting enemies until the trophy pops — if it stays quiet, fire the cannon. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so bring armor and a fast exit plan.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks for a clean, undetected jewelry-store robbery, and it starts with the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That mission unlocks the Snap Gun, a permanent lockpick that opens alarmed doors quietly without needing to be equipped. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — never kick the door, or the alarm goes off. Inside, look for the note with the safe code in the back room, then loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: This silver asks you to rob five bank vaults and escape, and it opens with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, where you wait at the cafe. After that introduction, follow a security van to its bank, wait for the guard to carry a bag into the vault, and slip in while it is open. Bring your partner so you can hand over a bag, and after the quest, pay Yasmani ten thousand dollars for tips on van locations. Each vault robbery triggers a four-star wanted level, so plan a fast bike and a fresh vehicle for the getaway. One bank can pay up to two hundred and five thousand dollars.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to rob an armored truck and escape, and the safest way opens in the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is — robbing the big bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. The faster route is to block a truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door, and blow it open, but beware: the trophy is reported to fail if you rob a truck directly. Stick with the bank-vault route for a clean pop, and remember sticky bombs become available behind Yasmani's shop after his quest.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to clear the fog from the entire map of Leonida. The fastest way is to fly a plane over every blacked-out area until the map fills in — walking or driving the whole state takes far longer. There is no checklist of spots to tick off; the map itself is the tracker. Do it after the story, when the whole map is open and you have aircraft available, and the trophy pops once the last fog clears.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs in Leonida. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy is just the first step on a longer road. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get close, and many are marked automatically during the story. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs, where the robbed total sits at the bottom right of each gang's page.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This bronze was one of the last trophies to be solved — the answer only surfaced on the evening of 20 November. Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar at the Oceanview Hotel on Ocean Beach, walk past the pool, and take the lift up to the rooftop. Buy an Apple Martini for ten dollars at the rooftop bar and drink it while standing beside the bar. The trophy pops once you take that first sip with the view in front of you.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This bronze is a nod to the classic showroom smash: after you get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, head to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City. Clone the key of the blue Bravado Banshee inside, then drive straight through the showroom window and keep going until the trophy pops — the pop is slightly delayed. It is marked as reported rather than confirmed, because one of its sources lists it that way, but the steps are fully written out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to steal three valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, which is one of the gang operations: a luxury watch in the southeast office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a northeast corner table, and a safe in the northeast corridor that you blow open with a sticky bomb. The trophy does not pop when you grab the third item — it pops only after you escape the police. If you do not finish it in one visit, the robbery marker comes back after a while, so it is never missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time — check it under the touchpad menu, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength, marked with a heart icon. It only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission, when you can switch characters. Raise Strength by working out: buy a fitness-club membership, found under Map then Activities with a dumbbell icon, or work out at home after the story. Always bring your partner along, because when one character works out, the other gains progress too. Note the disagreement: one source calls this a story trophy, while the main guide says it is about maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This bronze asks for 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile, and it almost certainly pops on its own during a normal playthrough. Your current count shows when you click the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on the profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, and every reputation-shifting action flashes a small demon-face icon on the right of the screen. Profiles range from Professional to Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, making police far more aggressive, so avoid endless violence.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This bronze was solved only on the evening of 20 November. Go back to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, Vice City — the same one Lucia robbed in the prologue — and play as Lucia alone, without Jason. Rob it again just like in the prologue: aim at the teller and take the money, then escape on foot, not in a vehicle. The trophy pop is delayed, so keep running until it appears. There is a disagreement on timing: the main guide says it works from Chapter 2, while another says you need the Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This bronze was solved only on the evening of 20 November, and it starts with a random UFO event. After Chapter 1, go alone to the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, east of Port Gellhorn, after 02:00 in-game time. Look for a parked car with flashing lights at the roadside — if it is not there, leave and come back, because the spawn is random. Follow the trail into the forest toward the blue light, where a UFO is lifting a woman; help her, fetch her car, and the UFO comes back to abduct you. That abduction pops the trophy, and it works as either Jason or Lucia.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This is the only trophy in the set whose unlock is still unverified, and honesty matters more here than a confident guess. The strongest lead is a melee drive-by kick from a motorcycle, but no source has proven the exact steps yet, so do not treat the lead as a finished method. It is a hidden bronze trophy in the official list, and it sits in roadmap stage 3 while the community keeps testing. If a confirmed method appears, this entry should be updated — until then, it stays marked unknown.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to launder a cumulative two hundred and fifty thousand dollars in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — that opens the Dye Pack Jammer for washing marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the best. The total does not need to come at once, and it builds naturally while you do every robbery for 100%. One bank vault alone can pay up to two hundred and five thousand dollars.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to spend a cumulative one hundred thousand dollars across all shops, and the fastest way is to buy the expensive stuff: weapons, car mods, and tattoos. The money counts across every shop type, so normal shopping during the story already moves the total. If you are short near the end, a tattoo studio or a fully modded car closes the gap in one visit. There is no deadline and no single purchase requirement — the total just needs to reach one hundred thousand.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to buy all eight purchasable garages, which cost one hundred and sixty thousand dollars in total. The four story garages do not count toward it. Garages become buyable after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses, which installs the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Buy them through that app, and fund them with robbery money — the Chapter 3 and 4 robberies pay the best. A location guide lists all twelve garage spots if you want to plan the route.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: This bronze asks you to register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which lets you call stolen vehicles to your location. The app installs after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. You need a garage first, since each garage adds parking slots. Bring a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. Early on he only takes vehicles without trackers, but from Chapter 3 you can register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
